summary: Feature request to implement an S3 external storage driver for the Temporal Go SDK, enabling users to store large payloads externally in Amazon S3.
userImpact: Enables users with large workflow payloads to leverage S3 for external storage instead of storing everything in the Temporal database.
proposedFix: Implement an S3 external storage driver for the Go SDK as part of the cross-SDK external storage initiative.
